scientific_integrity: The arbitrary-region statement is proved analytically by identifying coboundary parity with a binary incidence kernel. Finite code checks are corroborative only. Downstream thermalization statements are explicitly attributed to the cited source theorem.
scientific_limitations: The criterion characterizes the trivial high-temperature expansion only; it does not establish DS or MLSI beyond the hypotheses of the cited theorem.
The degree-three example is a local incidence witness, not a complete translation-invariant lattice construction.
A recent or differently indexed equivalent observation may exist.
title: A binary-rank criterion for trivial CSS high-temperature expansions
